item.title: Gigaverse launches $20,000 The Awakening event
item.summary: Gigaverse has kicked off The Awakening, a two-month event designed to close out the current version of its Abstract-based RPG while preparing players and its economy for the forthcoming MMORPG Gigaverse Online. At the heart of The Awakening are Hard Cores, a new event resource players are encouraged to accumulate.
